At the Kansai Economic Law Study Group (co-organized by the Kobe University platform KAKENHI project), I presented my research on self-preferencing by digital platforms.

The presentation was based on an article in progress that I plan to finish by March 2023.

Parts of the argument were not yet clear, so I will now revise the article substantially in light of the comments I received at the meeting.
